review.official:
Vulcan is a blacksmith from
Minos
who sought treatment at
Rhodes Island
after contracting
Oripathy
, ultimately reaching an agreement to become a part of the team.
In charge of smithing and maintaining weapons for other
Operators
, Vulcan also goes on missions when necessary.

files.description:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in her circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming her as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 18% 
High level of infection, obvious signs of Originium episodes on face and neck. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.38u/L 
Infection entering mid-stage, but currently unable to diagnose effects on the Operator.

Vulcan has an unwelcoming attitude for a lady blacksmith. 
She is not even remotely interested in anything not related to weaponry, and when it comes to armaments she's only a bit more talkative than usual. 
She made the smithy Rhodes Island provided her into her own bedroom, which she almost never leaves unless she's got a mission.

No one fights quite like Vulcan does. She relies on her dependable equipment and powerful prosthetics in combat. As such, she is constantly repairing her equipment. Gear gets damaged in battle, that's normal, but Vulcan has mastered the art of quick repair even under fire. Keeping equipment functional is essential to her battle tactics. 
In contrast, most Medic Operators don't have a clue about blacksmithing.

Vulcan always says those who can't keep up with the times are doomed to obsolescence. 
The march of time has changed the smithing trade from the sweaty man hitting an anvil to an advanced automation engineer creating weapons at maximum efficiency. 
In Vulcan's workshop, for instance, are several of the most advanced machines on the planet that are regularly improved. It is also in this secluded corner that all weapons at Rhodes Island are refined and upgraded.

Still, the most eye-catching thing in Vulcan's smithy is not any of the advanced robotic machines, but the enormous anvil and furnace. Yes, the very 'obsolescence' she spoke of. 
And yet, Vulcan still fires up the forge to hammer a piece of steel on the anvil, just like blacksmiths of old. 
Of course, that has nothing to do with making or maintaining our weaponry, and is more like a ritual, though she has never explained its meaning. 
Perhaps to her, those who can't keep up with times should become obsolete, but those who completely forsake tradition should not be called blacksmiths.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hm? You want to watch me forge weapons? Sure, but be careful not to get singed.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Only weapons that don't see use go undamaged. Therefore, a spotless weapon is actually a terrible sacrilege.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Nowadays, weapon and equipment manufacturing is all modernized. Traditional craftsmen lose their livelihoods because of it. Times change. Those who can't keep up get left behind... that's only natural.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Firearms… these weapons will change the world completely.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My right leg? Oh, It's no big deal. You know, all craftsmen make mistakes.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you for giving me a chance to show what I can do.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You saw my name engraved on some equipment? Well, no need to mind that. Probably has nothing to do with me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Steel and bronze form the bone, and then…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: If me and my hammer can still be of use to you, I'm honored.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: They're promoting new drinks at the bar... What should I have today?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Vulcan, that's what everyone calls me. I can do maintenance on your weapons, if it comes up. The equipment I need for the forge is listed here, in this blueprint.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hmm… I'm feeling inspired. Gotta start the blowers. It's time to work.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A skilled craftsman is crucial to a military organization. I see you understand that well.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Keeping your weapons in good condition is the best way to keep your people safe. You agree with me? Seems I made the right choice joining you.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I just want to focus on my work.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You're making me the leader…? If you insist… Still, I'm much better at designing and producing weapons than giving orders.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Can I stay behind and work? No?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hopeless imbeciles...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm on it.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Ready and waiting.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Armed up!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Let the fires rage!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I don't need healing.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Your weapon will shatter under my next blow!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Please bring me any enemy equipment you find. I want to know what they're making now.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A victory, just as planned! This is why we need high-quality equipment for our fighters.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Please submit damage reports for all of your equipment. I'll work on repairs when we get back.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: My skills are still lacking…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Do you have a furnace here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Argh...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Any equipment you have in mind? I can try making it for you.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. A moment please, I'm working the forge. In our trade, we believe that the flames must burn bright over the new year, so that we'll be able to craft strong equipment.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I'm not precisely sure what to give you as a present, since you don't need weapons. But the bar has been mixing some new drinks lately, and they've still got the ones I like. So how about I buy you a drink?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: People at Rhodes Island are beginning to understand the wonders of weapons. I was used to being alone, but now I get a few regular visitors... not that I mind. It's kind of fun, actually. Sometimes I even feel like a few more would be nice.
